As part of building our Maintenance Engineering organization, we are expanding our team with a Process Equipment Engineer focused on our Furnace Area. This is an opportunity to contribute to a technically advanced manufacturing environment and play an important part in strengthening our capabilities within the Furnace Area.
Read more about Silex here.
The team and the area
You will be part of the Maintenance Engineering organization and report to the Maintenance Manager. The Teams purpose is to provide technical leadership for assigned equipment and work closely with Team Managers, Service Technicians, Maintenance Engineers, Process Engineers, Area Managers, and external suppliers.
The Furnace Area is an important part of our production and includes advanced high-temperature processes such as epitaxy, Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD), and thermal oxidation. These processes are used to grow and deposit controlled material layers and to form high-quality oxide films, making stable temperature profiles, gas flows, pressure, and equipment conditions essential to product quality and process repeatability. You will bridge equipment maintenance and process engineering, using equipment data, process results, and production feedback to identify causes of instability, improve uptime and utilization, and ensure that technical actions are coordinated across teams.
About the role
As a Process Equipment Engineer, you will be responsible for the technical health, reliability, and continuous improvement of equipment within the Furnace Area. Equipment is your primary discipline, supported by process knowledge that enables effective fault analysis, improvement work, and close collaboration with Process Engineers.
You will act as the technical lead for the assigned equipment, guide service technicians, coordinate technical escalations, and lead root cause analyses of downtime events and recurring failures. You will also develop equipment monitoring and preventive maintenance, define relevant KPIs, contribute to equipment purchases and upgrades, and serve as a technical contact for suppliers.
In this role, you will:

Act as the technical lead for assigned furnace equipment, guiding service technicians and leading complex troubleshooting, root cause analyses, and follow-up of corrective actions.

Manage technical escalation plans and coordinate equipment status, priorities, and actions with Team Managers, Process Engineers, and suppliers.

Use equipment and process data to identify causes of instability, define and follow up KPIs such as uptime, MTBF, and MTTR, and improve equipment monitoring through equipment dashboard and SPC.

Develop preventive maintenance routines, maintain technical documentation, and contribute to equipment purchases, installations, upgrades, and spare-part planning.

Lead equipment-related risk analyses and ensure LOTO and other safety requirements are reflected in maintenance routines, documentation, and training.

We are looking for someone who has:

A Master’s degree in a relevant field, such as Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, or a related discipline.

At least five years of relevant experience in manufacturing with strong equipment-related knowledge and an understanding of production processes. Experience in semiconductor or MEMS process development or manufacturing is an advantage.

Experience with root cause analysis, data analysis, SPC, quality-control methods, equipment monitoring, and preventive maintenance systems.

Proficiency in English, particularly in technical terminology and documentation. Swedish is considered as highly meritorious.

To thrive in this role, you enjoy working analytically and finding practical solutions to complex technical challenges. You take a structured and proactive approach to your work, communicate clearly with different stakeholders, and are comfortable guiding others. With several activities often running in parallel, you are also able to prioritize effectively and ensure that actions are documented and followed through.
What we offer you

The opportunity to work with cutting-edge MEMS technology and some of the most advanced equipment in the industry.

A technically challenging environment where you solve complex problems and continuously develop your expertise.

A varied role in which new challenges, technologies, and improvement opportunities make every day different.

About Silex
Silex is the world’s largest and most advanced pure-play MEMS foundry, headquartered in Stockholm. MEMS is present in nearly all modern technology, from personal gadgets to automotive electronics, medical monitoring and testing equipment, and thermal management systems. With a team of expert engineers, operators, technicians, support staff, specialists, and more, Silex brings the ideas and concepts of the industry’s leading MEMS innovators to life.
The recruitment process
We have an ongoing recruitment process and therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. To apply, please attach your CV and answer a few questions. Our process is competency-based and includes a personality and logic test as well as reference checks. Additionally, we will conduct a background check and drug test prior to employment, and as an employer, we perform random alcohol and drug tests for all employees.

How do you secure renewable energy assets where industrial control systems, cloud platforms and cybersecurity come together? At OX2, protecting wind, solar and energy storage facilities mean understanding both the technology behind energy production and the risks that come with connected systems. We are now looking for a OT Security Lead to take ownership of our cybersecurity priorities with operational technology at the center and help shape how security is managed across our growing energy portfolio.
YOU WILL
OX2 is a renewable energy company developing, constructing, owning and operating large-scale wind, solar and energy storage projects. As the company expands its role as an independent power producer, cybersecurity is an important part of ensuring that its energy assets and the systems supporting them remain secure and reliable.  As OT Security Lead, you will take overall responsibility for cybersecurity across OX2's IT and operational technology environments, with a clear focus on OT. You will work across industrial control systems, cloud platforms and corporate IT, setting security requirements and ensuring that risks are understood and addressed throughout the development and operation of energy assets.
You will make risk-based decisions about which security measures are needed, where they should be implemented and how they should be prioritized across different facilities. Working closely with plant engineers, IT teams, suppliers and senior stakeholders, you will translate security requirements into practical solutions that work in operational environments.
Your main responsibilities will be to:

Own and prioritize the CSMS pipeline across OX2's wind, solar and energy storage assets.

Define security architecture and requirements across OT and IT, including SCADA, plant control systems, remote sites, Azure, AWS and SaaS environments.

Apply IEC 62443 and security principles such as zones and conduits, secure remote access, least privilege and security by design.

Establish and enforce cybersecurity requirements for suppliers, technology partners and external service providers.

Assess cybersecurity risks in vendor selection, acquisitions and divestments, contributing to cyber due diligence.

Govern external security partners and managed security service providers, including incident response and security delivery.

Translate NIS2 and relevant cybersecurity legislation into practical security measures across the business

The role involves collaboration across OX2's international business.

YOU ARE 
You have a strong background in cybersecurity. You understand the challenges of protecting systems where security, availability and operational requirements need to work together. You have worked with OT and industrial control systems, including areas such as SCADA, plant networks and remote access. You have practical experience with IEC 62443 and understand how to apply security principles such as network segmentation, zones and conduits, least privilege and security by design. You also understand the connections between OT, corporate IT and cloud environments.
Your experience extends beyond individual projects. You have taken responsibility for security across multiple sites or technical environments, setting priorities, assessing risks and ensuring that security measures are implemented. You are used to working with external suppliers and know how to establish requirements and challenge solutions. Experience with MSSP governance, incident response or cyber due diligence is particularly valuable.
You are naturally curious and enjoy exploring new technologies and approaches to security. You make well-founded decisions. You can discuss technical details with engineers while explaining risks and priorities clearly to management. Most importantly, you follow through and make sure security requirements lead to real improvements. You have a relevant educational background and are fluent in English. Experience from energy, utilities, industrial automation or other critical infrastructure environments is particularly valuable, but not essential if you bring strong practical OT security experience.
At OX2, you will have the opportunity to influence how cybersecurity is managed across an international portfolio of renewable energy assets. You will work close to the technology behind energy production, with the responsibility and autonomy to develop security capabilities that protect both current operations and future assets.
WANT TO KNOW MORE? 
For questions about the role, please contact recruitment consultant Johanna Värmfors at johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com or +46 730 821 230, or Artan Bitiqi at artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com or +46 723 61 28 44.
We are looking forward hearing from you!
ABOUT OX2
OX2 is a renewable energy company accelerating the transition to a sustainable energy system. Through its integrated model as an independent power producer (IPP), OX2 develops, constructs, owns and manages renewable energy assets across onshore and offshore wind, solar and energy storage.  With a diversified portfolio of approximately 33 GW across development, construction, asset management and operations, OX2 combines entrepreneurial project development with long-term ownership and value creation. The company operates in five European markets and Australia, has approximately 500 employees, and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.  OX2 is owned by EQT, one of the world's largest private equity investors.

Utility is entering an exciting new chapter.
After being part of the Svea Solar Group, we are now an independent company with secured financing of up to EUR 185 million. Our ambition is to expand our operating portfolio of solar PV assets and Battery Energy Storage Systems to more than 2 GW over the next five years, roughly equivalent to the capacity of two large nuclear reactors.
For our Finance team, that means growth, new legal entities and plenty of opportunities to build and improve how we work.
Just to clarify: As Utility became their very own company just recently, their jobs are currently posted through the former owner Svea Solar.
The role and the team
We asked your future Senior Accountant colleague what makes her enjoy the role, and the answer is simple: the people.
Utility consists of 35 colleagues, and the team is a big part of why she enjoys coming to work. There is trust and a strong sense of collaboration. You own your work, while having colleagues around you who are always willing to help and share their knowledge.
As a standalone company, you also have the flexibility to build reports and annual reports in the way that works best for the business, while having a real opportunity to influence processes.
Today, the team works with around 30 legal entities, with many transactions, intercompany flows and reconciliations.
Some days are about getting the basics right across many companies. Others are about solving problems, improving processes or finding smarter ways to work.
As your future colleague puts it: “The challenge isn’t the complexity of the accounting. It’s the volume.” We’re also on the brink of introducing AI into our finance processes, and you’ll have the opportunity to play an important part in that journey. By automating some of the more repetitive, high-volume tasks, AI will hopefully help free up your time to focus on more complex and value-adding accounting work.
Responsibilities
Overall responsible, together with another colleague, for bookkeeping for assigned business units within Svea Solar Utility.

Ensure accurate and timely monthly and year-end close.

Monthly Group reporting and quarterly consolidated reporting.

Ensure correct balance sheet accounts through detailed reconciliations.

P&L analysis and accruals.

VAT reconciliations, filings and periodic EU reporting.

Participate in completing annual reports and audits.

Act as bank access administrator, monitoring liquidity and bank accounts and managing payment executions.

Be part of various projects to identify improvements in processes and systems, for example exploring how AI can improve efficiency.

Other ad-hoc projects that might arise in a fast-paced finance department.

Requirements
Proven track record in a senior accounting role.

Experience working with Swedish GAAP K3.

Thorough understanding of financial regulations, accounting principles and reporting standards.

Experience developing and implementing new routines and processes.

Proficient in business communication in both English and Swedish.

Valuable experience, but not required:

Experience working in a balance-sheet-heavy business.

Experience with consolidation and operating in a multi-legal-entity environment with many intercompany flows.

Experience working in Cognos.

Personal qualities
Own It: Takes initiative to drive improvements and moves processes forward with a solution-oriented mindset.
Accuracy: Works systematically and delivers high-quality work across a high volume of accounting tasks, while staying organised and meeting deadlines.
Create Good Vibes & Do It Together: Contributes to a positive team environment by bringing energy, supporting colleagues and sharing knowledge. Gives both positive and constructive feedback in a respectful and encouraging way.
What we offer you
Make a big impact in a growing company. We’re still a relatively lean organisation, which means your ideas, decisions and initiatives can have a real impact on how we grow and work.

Be part of the energy transition at scale. Contribute to a cleaner energy future through large-scale solar parks and innovative energy solutions.

Stable benefits, and the best benefit of all: the people. 30 days of vacation, occupational pension, healthcare allowance, parking, the option to work from home up to two days a week, regular after works and, most importantly, an engaged and inclusive team.

About us
Svea Solar Utility (“SSU”) is a leading Swedish solar IPP with currently 8 solar parks in operation, totaling 75 MWp, 2 parks under construction, totaling 125 MWp, and a development pipeline of over 3 GW across more than 100 projects.
SSU was, until May 2026, an independently managed subsidiary of Svea Renewable Solar AB (“Svea Group”), but is now majority-owned directly by Altor, a leading Swedish Private Equity firm. The full separation from Svea Group is ongoing, and as part of the process, SSU will be rebranded during autumn 2026. Read our press release here.

Job Description
WHAT YOU’LL DO
As a Sales Advisor at H&M, you’ll play a key role in creating an outstanding customer experience. You’ll welcome customers, guide them through your store, and support them in finding what they need while showcasing our products. Acting in line with our values, you’ll contribute to both your own success and the success of the company.
You will:
Share your fashion and product knowledge to help customers make informed choices.
Collaborate with your team to deliver exceptional service at every step of the customer journey.
Ensure the sales floor and back of house are well-stocked, organized, and inviting.
Support with opening and closing of the store.
Represent yourself and the brand positively during all customer interactions.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers experience our brand firsthand. As part of the dynamic Store Team, every role—from Sales Advisors, Department Managers, Store Managers and Visual Merchandisers to Assistant Store Managers, Cash Office Responsible, and Delivery Responsible in larger stores—contributes to creating an inspiring and welcoming environment. You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.

WHO YOU ARE
We are looking for people with…
Experience in customer service within fashion, retail, or similar fields.

And people who are…
Passionate about fashion and delivering an exceptional in-store experience while promoting our products and driving sales.
Thriving in collaborative and dynamic environments.
Communicative, creative, curious to work with store technology, with a strong eagerness to learn and develop.
Flexible and action oriented.

WHO WE ARE
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.
We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE 
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.
 All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. 
In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here. 

JOIN US
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.
This is a temporary position offering 8 hours per week for 3 months, with start in November or by agreement. The role is based in Kungens Kurva and you should be available to work during store opening hours. Language skills in Swedish or English are required.
We have an ongoing selection, so the position may be filled before the application deadline, so send in your application today! The last application date is 21/10.
Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.
* Store roles assessment: 
To manage the high volume of applications for the Sales Advisor role, we use an online assessment method for skills-based recruitment within some of our stores. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies predefined criteria set by H&M Group. Please look out for an email in your inbox/junk email from MAKI. 
After completing the assessment, you’ll have the opportunity to share feedback and ask questions. If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact on your application. 
For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice. 
** We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

jobs.description:
EYKON operates as an independent utility infrastructure technology company built on more than 130 years of utility expertise. Headquartered in Switzerland, with a network of expert local teams, the company serves customers in more than 75 markets and supports over 100 million connected endpoints across the region.
Combining proven metering technology, deep utility expertise and real-world operational insight from one of the largest installed bases in EMEA, EYKON connects what utilities measure with how they operate. This helps customers gain greater visibility, make better decisions, maintain greater control and unlock more value from the infrastructure they already operate.
Do you want to play a key role in the green energy transition while working in the intersection of technology, customer support and commercial development?
EYKON is looking for a Technical Sales Support Engineer to support customers and sales activities across Scandinavia. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys building relationships, coordinating stakeholders and solving a wide variety of customer and business challenges in an international environment.
In this role, you will become a central part of the Scandinavian organisation. Acting as the link between customers, sales teams, product management and technical specialists, you will help ensure that customers receive the right support while contributing to the continued growth of the business across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.
The Role
As Technical Sales Support Engineer, you will support Scandinavian customers and the Nordic Sales organisation across EYKON's portfolio of hardware, software and service solutions. The role combines customer support, pre-sales, order management and stakeholder coordination in a truly international environment.
Your responsibilities will include:
Supporting customers across Denmark, Sweden and Norway.
Coordinating customer-related activities and acting as the customer's internal ambassador.
Working in close cooperations with order management team
 Following up on logistics, deliveries and customer commitments.
Providing technical and commercial support to the sales organisation
Supporting tenders, RFQs and commercial projects.
Participating in pre-sales initiatives and customer-facing activities.
Conducting customer, market and competitor analysis.
Coordinating activities between customers and internal specialists.
Supporting customer training, product documentation and knowledge transfer together with Training team och Product Management.

This is a highly collaborative role where your ability to build relationships and navigate different stakeholder groups will be just as important as your technical understanding. You will work closely with experienced specialists while gradually developing extensive knowledge of EYKON's products, solutions and customers.
The preferred location is Sorø, Denmark, but strong candidates located in Sweden, particularly in the Örebro/Mälardalen region, will also be considered. Travel within Scandinavia is included in the role.

Experience and/or knowledge of public procurement processes.

jobs.occupation: Systems Architect to Mycronic PCB Assembly Solutions
jobs.description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life. Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and shaping the architecture of advanced products? Then you might be the person we’re looking for!
About the role
Mycronic has experienced strong growth in recent years, both organically and through acquisitions. With headquarters in Sweden, Mycronic is a global organization with subsidiaries, agents, and distributors in over 50 countries. In this role, you will be part of Mycronic's PCB Assembly Solutions division (PA), a leading provider of equipment and solutions for surface mount technology (SMT). Our solutions enable electronics manufacturers to adapt production quickly while maintaining high efficiency, ranging from individual systems for specific process steps to complete production lines and advanced software for assembly process management and connected factories. 
We Offer
A strategic role where you will have a significant influence on the direction of our world-leading Jet Printing product. 
The opportunity to work with new technology and contribute to innovation together with our Jet Printing core development team of 15 specialists across software, mechanics, electronics, configuration management, testing, product management, as well as collaborate with a wide range of functions across the company. 
A culture of innovation and collaboration, working together at our Kista office.

 
Work tasks
As a Systems Architect, you will lead the definition, development, and evolution of robust, scalable, and sustainable system architectures. You will provide the architectural perspective that connects our engineering disciplines and helps translate business and customer needs into technical direction. To do this effectively, you will invest the necessary time to truly understand our products and customers. This includes gaining firsthand experience of their perspective by using our systems during experiments, exploring new opportunities, and developing a deep understanding of how our solutions are used in practice.
Your responsibilities will include:
Lead and align cross-functional technical development, ensuring that software, electronics, mechanics, and mechatronics work together as an integrated system. 
Explore and drive the use of AI to deepen our understanding of the product, identify new opportunities, and improve how we develop and evolve our solutions.
Lead workshops and facilitate discussions around business and technical needs. Balance the overall architectural perspective with the necessary technical details while engaging others in developing concepts that meet customer and product requirements.
Support sales at customer-specific development by performing requirement analyses and product definition.
Establish, develop and share knowledge of current and future manufacturing technologies.

We are looking for
You are a true team player with an open and positive mindset, a strong sense of responsibility, and the ability to thrive in a global, fast-changing environment. You bring a pragmatic approach to product development, knowing when to push for improvements and when to recognize what already works well. You communicate clearly and effectively with people across different roles and areas of expertise, and take a thoughtful, structured approach to moving work forward, understanding what needs to be done, which competencies are needed, and when to involve the right people.
Furthermore, you have: 
A Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering Physics, Electronics, Mechatronics or similar. 
Solid experience in systems architecture for complex products combining hardware and software.
Solid knowledge of systems engineering, both theoretical and practical. 
Experience translating stakeholder requirements into technical solutions.
Strong ability to lead technical discussions and drive decisions.
Experience leading technical projects or product development activities.
Strong communication skills in English.

Knowledge of Swedish. 
Proven experience in exploring and driving the use of AI in product development.

Drive ideas and develop concepts from a tech perspective.

Explore ideas iteratively and refine them into production-quality solutions.

Contribute to improving the architecture, tech stack, and operational methods.

Improve our AI development workflow to support safe and reliable production AI.

Follow and promote good engineering practices to deliver high-quality products.

Be a positive force for our team culture.
